description:
Meet the Beacon Pro, a bold stretch-frame cruiser featuring distinctive 140H wheel styling, wide whitewall tires, and classic chopper-inspired lines. Designed for riders who want a bike with personality, whether cruising the boardwalk, exploring the neighborhood, or enjoying a relaxed weekend ride.
The front of the bike is equipped with a reliable PS75A coaster brake, providing smooth and efficient stopping power for enhanced safety during your rides. The 80mm front wheel ensures stability and control, allowing you to confidently navigate various terrains with ease.
The rear of the Tracer Beacon Pro features a robust PS95 coaster brake with a 95mm wheel, enhancing overall braking performance and ensuring a secure and controlled ride. The 26" by 14G by 140H front wheel and the 24" by 14G by 140H rear wheel combination not only contributes to the bike's distinctive appearance but also provides a smooth and comfortable ride.
Crafted with precision and attention to detail, the Tracer Beacon Pro features a stretched cruiser frame that not only adds a touch of elegance but also contributes to a relaxed riding posture. The 14G spokes on both wheels enhance durability, ensuring a sturdy build that can withstand the rigors of regular use.
Whether you're cruising down the boardwalk, exploring the neighborhood, or commuting to work, the Tracer Beacon Pro 26" Stretch Cruiser Bike is designed to turn heads while delivering a comfortable and enjoyable ride. Elevate your cycling experience with this stylish and reliable cruiser that combines performance and aesthetics in one impressive package
